model_annotation: The bar chart, labeled Figure 2, displays negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between a baseline model, Mistral-v0.2, and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty's data. The horizontal axis lists six medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics; these categories are represented by bars of distinct colors, though the exact shades are not specified. The vertical axis represents negative log-probability, with values ranging from approximately 5.7 to 6.3, marked at intervals of 0.1, and labeled with numerical values. Each specialty's bar shows a decrease in negative log-probability from the baseline to the fine-tuned model, with the average decrease represented by a group label. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bar is visually emphasized beyond the standard representation. Overall, the chart illustrates the change in token probability across different clinical specialties when the model is fine-tuned on specific datasets.
